verses.en: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.pt: Cantai ao SENHOR, vós que sois justos; aos corretos convém louvar.
verses.en_web: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
verses.en_bbe: Be glad in the Lord, O doers of righteousness; for praise is beautiful for the upright.

verses.en: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.pt: Louvai ao SENHOR com harpa; cantai a ele com alaúde e instrumento de dez cordas.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord on the corded instrument; make melody to him with instruments of music.

verses.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.pt: Cantai-lhe uma canção nova; tocai instrumento bem com alegria.
verses.en_web: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!
verses.en_bbe: Make a new song to him; playing expertly with a loud noise.

verses.en: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.pt: Porque a palavra do SENHOR é correta; e todas suas obras são fiéis.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
verses.en_bbe: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his works are certain.

verses.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
verses.pt: Ele ama a justiça e o juízo; a terra está cheia da bondade do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: His delight is in righteousness and wisdom; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

verses.en: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.pt: Pala palavra do SENHOR foram feitos os céus; e todo o seu exército foi feito pelo sopro de sua boca.
verses.en_web: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made; all their army by the breath of his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the army of heaven by the breath of his mouth.

verses.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.pt: Ele junta as águas do mar como se estivessem empilhadas; aos abismos ele põe como depósitos de tesouros.
verses.en_web: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
verses.en_bbe: He makes the waters of the sea come together in a mass; he keeps the deep seas in store-houses.

verses.en: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.pt: Toda a terra, tenha temor ao SENHOR; todos os moradores do mundo prestem reverência a ele.
verses.en_web: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.en_bbe: Let the earth be full of the fear of the Lord; let all the people of the world be in holy fear of him.

verses.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.pt: Porque ele falou, e logo se fez; ele mandou, e logo apareceu.
verses.en_web: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
verses.en_bbe: For he gave the word, and it was done; by his order it was fixed for ever.

verses.en: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.pt: O SENHOR desfez a intenção das nações; ele destruiu os planos dos povos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord undoes the designs of the nations; he makes the thoughts of the peoples without effect.

verses.en: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.pt: O conselho do SENHOR permanece para sempre; as intenções de seu coração continuam de geração após geração.
verses.en_web: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord's purpose is eternal, the designs of his heart go on through all the generations of man.

verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD: and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurada é a nação em que seu Deus é o SENHOR; o povo que ele escolheu para si por herança.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has taken for his heritage.

verses.en: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.pt: O SENHOR olha desde os céus; ele vê a todos os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is looking down from heaven; he sees all the sons of men;

verses.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.pt: Desde sua firme morada ele observa a todos os moradores da terra.
verses.en_web: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,
verses.en_bbe: From his house he keeps watch on all who are living on the earth;

verses.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.pt: Ele forma o coração de todos eles; ele avalia todas as obras deles.
verses.en_web: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.
verses.en_bbe: He makes all their hearts; their works are clear to him.

verses.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.pt: O rei não se salva pela grandeza de seu exército, nem o valente escapa do perigo pela sua muita força.
verses.en_web: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
verses.en_bbe: A king's salvation is not in the power of his army; a strong man does not get free by his great strength.

verses.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.pt: O cavalo é falho como segurança, com sua grande força não livra do perigo.
verses.en_web: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
verses.en_bbe: A horse is a false hope; his great power will not make any man free from danger.

verses.en: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.pt: Eis que os olhos do SENHOR estão sobre aqueles que o temem, sobre os que esperam pela sua bondade.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness;
verses.en_bbe: See, the eye of the Lord is on those in whose hearts is the fear of him, on those whose hope is in his mercy;

verses.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.pt: Para livrar a alma deles da morte, e para os manter vivos durante a fome.
verses.en_web: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
verses.en_bbe: To keep their souls from death; and to keep them living in time of need.

verses.en: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
verses.pt: Nossa alma espera no SENHOR; ele é nossa socorro e nosso escudo.
verses.en_web: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.
verses.en_bbe: Our souls are waiting for the Lord; he is our help and our salvation.

verses.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.pt: Porque nele nosso coração se alegra, porque confiamos no nome de sua santidade.
verses.en_web: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.en_bbe: For in him our hearts have joy; in his holy name is our hope.

verses.en: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.pt: Que tua bondade, SENOR, esteja sobre nós, assim como nós esperamos em ti. Salmo de Davi, quando ele mudou seu comportamento perante Abimeleque, que o expulsou, e ele foi embora:
verses.en_web: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
verses.en_bbe: Let your mercy be on us, O Lord, as we are waiting for you.
